task: Identify why a test fails and propose a minimal verified fix

variants.description: Inspect the failure evidence and relevant implementation to identify the cause
variants.expected_result: A supported explanation of the failure
variants.verification: Reproduce the failure with a focused test run

variants.description: Implement a minimal change after the cause is established
variants.verification: Check the original test and affected behavior
variants.constraints: Apply only after investigation; preserve unrelated behavior
